blind.description: A stylized wooden alms box or donation chest set atop a vertical wooden pedestal with a cross-shaped four-footed base. The chest features an arched lid with two dark iron reinforcing bands, a lock clasp with a padlock on the front, and reddish-brown inset panels on the chest body. The surfaces are smooth, solid, and cleanly modeled with stylized hand-painted textures.
blind.from_above: From directly above, it shows the top of the barrel-vaulted chest lid with two dark metal bands running across the wooden planks, flanked slightly below by the tips of the cross base, casting a distinctive keyhole/pedestal shadow.
blind.height_vs_figure: About half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (roughly 3 feet tall) and about 1.5 feet wide.
